title: Can AI Make Conflicts Worse? An Alignment Failure in LLM Deployment Across Conflict Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Automated behavioral evaluation using multi-turn synthetic scenarios drawn from real conflict contexts to test for harmful behaviors such as false balance, atrocity denial, and identity-blind analysis.
Injecting culturally specific coded language, ethnic slurs, and dog whistles into prompts to test whether the model recognizes and appropriately handles dehumanizing vernacular expressions.

Varying the regional setting of the underlying conflict scenarios (e.g., Middle East, Eastern Europe, Sub-Saharan Africa) to measure whether models demonstrate unequal sensitivity and knowledge across different geographic locations.

Evaluating models for 'dominant narrative exclusion' and visibility bias, measuring their tendency to default to elite, Western, or English-language perspectives while excluding marginalized, local, or indigenous community voices.
